subject: Re: Trial extension & cost model — token volumes and $/1M target
messages:
From: Elliot Rhodes <elliot@finovate.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-25T14:03:00-05:00
Subject: Quick recap + asks after today's demo

Jordan — thanks for the demo today. Quick recap from our side and two asks: 

Summary:
- We're running an initial POC with a payments fraud workflow.
- Estimated traffic for the pilot: ~6k requests/day. Typical request = 350 prompt tokens, ~150 completion tokens => ~500 tokens per request on average. That maps to ~3M tokens/day (pilot peak).
- Pilot duration target: 2 weeks (14 days).
- Primary success criteria: false positive reduction >15% and <200ms tail latency for ranked outputs.

Ask 1 — pricing target: Our finance lead wants a working target for unit cost: ideally <= $20 per 1M tokens during pilot. Can you confirm the model options and expected $/1M token ranges for the POC?

Ask 2 — credits: We're running up against our initial trial credits. Could Redwood provide a short-term extension (additional credits to cover at least 2M tokens) so we can complete the 2-week pilot without throttling?

Attached is a small usage sample and a sketch of expected request distribution. Happy to jump on a 20-30m call to align.

Thanks,
Elliot Rhodes
Head of Data Science | Finovate
[Attachment: usage_sample.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Rhodes <elliot@finovate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-25T16:18:00-05:00

Thanks Elliot — great meeting. Short answers and next steps below.

Pricing & unit economics:
- Pricing varies by model family. For a production-quality Llama-derivative quantized endpoint we typically see list-equivalent ranges of $6–$15 per 1M tokens when using optimized 8-bit runtimes. For larger high-performance families or unquantized instruction-tuned variants it's higher (roughly $20–$45 / 1M).
- Given your 500 tokens/request figure and the pilot peak of ~3M tokens/day, cost sensitivity is high. If you hit peak for several days, even conservative models will consume credits quickly.

Credit extension:
- We can provision a short-term trial extension from our side. I need approval for the amount; what's most helpful to understand is whether you want coverage for the full theoretical peak (3M/day * 14 days = 42M tokens) or a throttled pilot target (e.g., 1M/day * 14 days = 14M tokens).

Immediate proposal:
1) Short call tomorrow to settle on pilot throughput target (20–30m).
2) If you confirm a throttled target (e.g., 1M tokens/day), I can push for a 2-week credit extension of up to 10M tokens from the growth pool while I loop in Marissa for any above-threshold approvals.

CCing Marissa (sales lead) and Monica (customer success) to expedite the credit decision and to scope performance engineering help to reduce burn rate (caching, prefixing, response length caps).

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Requesting approvals / input:
- Marissa: can we approve up to 10M tokens from the growth trial credit pool for a 14-day POC? If >10M would require AE manager or rev ops sign-off.
- Monica: any quick wins to reduce token burn (response truncation, ranked rerank limits, caching prefix tokens)? If you can propose 2–3 adjustments we can include them in pilot runbook.
- Vivek: is there a specific model/endpoint you'd recommend for best cost/latency tradeoff given Finovate's constraints?

I want to keep momentum — their finance asked for a $/1M target of <= $20. If we can keep them to quantized endpoints and moderate throughput we should be able to hit that.

Thanks,
Jordan
